summary: Iteration 4 validated the new Product Detail Modal (frontend + backend). Backend pytest 21/21 passing (added TestStoreProductDetailFields class with 2 new tests asserting descriptionHtml, options, variants[].selectedOptions, variants[].image, variants[].compareAtPrice on both /api/store/products?first=N and ?collection=mejores-ventas). Frontend E2E: modal opens from both product-image and bestseller-image, gallery + thumbnails + nav arrows work, variant pills update active state, qty stepper increments/decrements (correctly disables dec at min=1), add-to-cart fires toast + button switches to 'Adicionado!' + 'Ver carrinho →' link appears, cart badge increments by chosen qty (verified 0 → 2), Ver carrinho link opens drawer with correct item & qty, Escape closes modal, i18n PT/EN flips 'Adicionar ao Carrinho'↔'Add to Cart' and 'Comprar Agora'↔'Buy Now', descriptionHtml renders sanitized HTML via [data-testid=modal-description-html]. All previous regression flows (newsletter, reviews, collections, checkout to lojavirtualvision.com) still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductModal.jsx — descriptionHtml is injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with no sanitization. Shopify's descriptionHtml is generally trustworthy, but for defense-in-depth consider DOMPurify before injection (XSS hardening).

ProductModal.jsx — useEffect that syncs gallery to variant.image (lines 70-76) sets imageIndex from variant change, but a user manually scrolling thumbnails then changing variant will jump back. Acceptable UX, but worth noting.

CartContext.jsx — add() merges by merchandiseId only, so the same product added at qty=1 then qty=2 yields qty=3 (correct merge). No upper-bound check on quantity; for very large carts consider clamping to e.g. 99 to match typical e-commerce UX.
ProductModal.jsx — image gallery uses native ; no lazy loading hint. Low priority since modal opens on demand.

shopify_client.py — PRODUCT_FRAGMENT now requests variants(first: 50) and images(first: 8). For products with >50 variants the picker may be incomplete; not an issue for current catalog but worth a code comment.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in app; Shopify Storefront token is live in backend/.env
seed_data_creation: No new seeds. Newsletter and reviews collections continue to be auto-seeded by backend on first request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Detail Modal is fully integrated. Backend exposes per-product: descriptionHtml(str), options[{id,name,values[]}], variants[].selectedOptions[{name,value}], variants[].image|null, variants[].compareAtPrice|null. Frontend: clicking [data-testid=product-image-{handle}] (ProductCard) or [data-testid=bestseller-image-{handle}] (BestSellers) calls openModal(product) from ProductModalContext; ProductModal renders shadcn Dialog at app root via App.js. Modal data-testids: product-modal, modal-gallery, modal-prev-image, modal-next-image, modal-thumb-{i}, modal-title, modal-price, modal-options, modal-option-{name}-{value}, modal-qty, modal-qty-inc, modal-qty-dec, modal-add-to-cart, modal-buy-now, modal-view-cart, modal-description, modal-description-html. CartContext.add now accepts (product, {variant, quantity, variantTitle, variantImage}). modal-qty-dec correctly carries the disabled attribute when qty==1 — playwright auto-wait will hang if you try to click it; assert state instead. i18n.modal dictionary provides {addToCart, buyNow, quantity, description, outOfStock, added, processing} for PT and EN. Buy-now flow is identical to cart drawer's checkout (POST /api/store/checkout with line then redirect to data.checkoutUrl on lojavirtualvision.com); not auto-clicked in E2E to avoid leaving the preview.
verified_features: Backend: /api/store/products?first=3 returns each product with descriptionHtml string, options array of {id,name,values}, variants with selectedOptions, image (or null), compareAtPrice (or null), no _id leak
Backend: /api/store/products?collection=mejores-ventas&first=3 returns the same enriched shape (PRODUCT_FRAGMENT reused)

Backend regression: /api/health, /api/store/collections, /api/store/checkout (real Shopify checkoutUrl to lojavirtualvision.com), /api/newsletter/subscribe, /api/reviews — all 21 pytest cases pass in 3.74s
Frontend: clicking [data-testid=bestseller-image-{handle}] opens the same modal
Modal renders modal-title ('Cortador de frutas e legumes multifuncional'), modal-price ('R$ 353,97'), modal-gallery, and 7 modal-thumb-{i} buttons
Modal gallery: modal-next-image and modal-prev-image cycle images with smooth crossfade
Variant pills: 3 modal-option-Cor-{value} buttons render; clicking modal-option-Cor-4 sets that value active and updates the main image (variant has its own image)
Qty stepper: starts at 1, modal-qty-inc bumps to 2 then 3, modal-qty-dec back to 2; modal-qty-dec is correctly disabled at qty=1 (cannot click — playwright correctly reports element is not enabled)
Add-to-cart: button text changes to 'Adicionado!', toast 'Adicionado ao carrinho!' fires, [data-testid=modal-view-cart] link appears
Cart badge: increments from 0 to 2 (matches chosen qty)
View cart link: closes modal and opens [data-testid=cart-drawer] which lists the added line with cart-qty-{handle} = 2
Modal close: Escape key closes modal cleanly (modal node removed from DOM)
i18n PT->EN toggle: 'Adicionar ao Carrinho' -> 'Add to Cart', 'Comprar Agora' -> 'Buy Now'
Description: modal-description-html renders sanitized HTML (modal-description plain fallback not used because Shopify provides descriptionHtml)
Backward compatibility: ProductCard's Adicionar button (no opts) still works via CartContext.add default branch (variants[0], qty=1)
